digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verify workflow routing and cancellation
propositions: Job-level always() predicates on seven full-route jobs remain true during workflow cancellation, preventing GitHub from canceling superseded matrix and reusable jobs that should be eliminated when a new patchset is uploaded.

Stale full-route jobs consume significant runner-seconds and delay successor job creation after a same-change patchset supersedes the prior run (evidence: run 31834162663 → 31834896849 consumed 1,785 runner-seconds and delayed successor by 1,510 seconds).

Replacing always() with !cancelled() status checks in the seven full-route predicates while preserving classifier-failure fallback behavior makes stale jobs eligible for prompt cancellation while keeping full-route jobs active on classifier failure or success.
Classifier-failure fallback and docs-only routing must remain fail-closed and blocking; cancellation of a superseded run is a distinct state that must not preserve stale work.

Live post-merge organic same-change replacements prove prompt cancellation: run 31846910968 (PS3) superseded by 31847788055 (PS4) canceled in 78 seconds with no wait for natural matrix completion; independent repeat of 31847788055 (PS4) superseded by 31849555779 (PS5) canceled in 110 seconds.
